Hannah / Marissa — I reviewed the redlines. Summary of legal posture:

1) Data residency appendix: Bridgewell requests EU-only persistence for customer data in the appendix. We can accept provided they agree to a SOC2-aligned controls attestation and allow Redwood to route processing to a US region for operational troubleshooting for a limited time-window (we'll add a 30-day notice for such access).
2) Indemnity: Bridgewell's proposed broad carve-out for third-party claims is too wide. Counter-propose replacing the blanket carve-out with a consequential-damage-limited indemnity tied to breach of Redwood obligations and gross negligence.
3) Audit notice: We can accept a 10-business-day notice for audits, but the scope should be mutual and limited to security controls only.

Execution notes:
- No notarization required; this can be done via DocuSign.
- Suggested envelope sequencing: Envelope A (MSA) — signers: Bridgewell CFO -> Redwood CEO. Envelope B (Order Form & SOWs) — signers: Bridgewell CFO -> Redwood authorized rep. We favor sequential envelopes to keep the MSA signature precedent clear.
- Clean copy: after final signature we will publish a PDF clean copy to the shared Drive and deliver via DocuSign combined PDF. Marissa, please prepare the clean-copy naming convention and retention location.

If Bridgewell confirms the signer list is final, I can ack the redline posture and we can proceed to send the DocuSign envelopes.

-Markus

Simon / Anna — per Markus and Marissa's review, here is the proposed execution runbook for the MSA + Order Form: 

1) Pre-reqs (today)
- Bridgewell to confirm final signer authority list (attached).
- Counterparty acceptance of legal posture items (data residency attestation, indemnity draft, 10-business-day audit notice).

2) Envelope sequencing (DocuSign)
- Envelope 1: MSA (PDF clean redline attached for reference)
  - Signing order: 1) Bridgewell CFO (primary signer) -> 2) Redwood CEO (final approver)
- Envelope 2: Order Form + Schedules
  - Signing order: 1) Bridgewell CFO -> 2) Redwood Authorized Rep (Contracts)

3) DocuSign details
- We will send sequential envelopes. Each envelope will include the Signature_Authority_List.xlsx as a reference (non-signable).
- Audience access: Bridgewell will receive proforma emails; if you prefer a single combined envelope we can convert but that will require both signers to be present in the same signing window.
- Clean-copy delivery: once both envelopes are fully executed, Redwood will publish a combined signed PDF to the shared Drive and send the clean copy as a DocuSign combined document and via secure link.

4) Timeline
- If signer list is confirmed today, envelope 1 will be sent by EOD (Wed 12/11). Envelope 2 will be queued to send automatically once envelope 1 is completed. Expect final clean copy delivery within 2 business days after signature.

5) Contingencies
- If Bridgewell requests simultaneous signing or an additional witness, let us know and we will update the envelope (may add 24 hours).
- If the indemnity language requires further negotiation, pause signature and route to Markus for a one-day turnaround.

Docs attached: Bridgewell_MSA_Redlines.pdf | Order_Form_Redlines.docx | Signature_Authority_List.xlsx
